# Malachi

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Malachi calls God's people back to covenant faithfulness while anticipating the coming Messenger. The book teaches that wholehearted devotion honors God and prepares the way for His redemption.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Malachi 1:11</div>

<div class="identifier">My name shall be great among the nations</div>

### Why This Verse

Universal worship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter affirms God's love for Israel while confronting their dishonorable worship. The key verse emphasizes that God deserves sincere honor and wholehearted devotion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Malachi 2:16</div>

<div class="identifier">I hate divorce, saith the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently cited marriage passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter rebukes corrupt priests and addresses covenant unfaithfulness in marriage. The key verse highlights God's desire for faithfulness in both worship and relationships.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Malachi 3:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse</div>

### Why This Verse

Most quoted verse in Malachi

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells the coming messenger and calls God's people to repentance. The key verse promises God's blessing upon those who faithfully honor Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Malachi 4:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Unto you that fear My name shall the Sun of righteousness arise</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous messianic promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the fate of the wicked and the righteous and promises the coming of Elijah. The key verse points to the coming day when God's justice and healing will be fully revealed.
:::
